title: Navigating the Journey to Mental Wellbeing: A Conversation on Finding the Right Therapist

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 各位心理学家，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱之外的收入，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己曾在2022年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的转型之路。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲提供的奖励，以及我额外提供的独家支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组大师课、大师班、个性化指导、一份Fortnum and Mason礼品，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 请通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，随时可以找我。

sentences.en: Coming up in today's episode, ever wondered why finding the right therapist is an absolute game changer?
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中，有没有想过为什么找到合适的治疗师是彻底改变人生的关键？

sentences.en: Well, buckle up because in today's episode, we're diving deep into the crucial reasons why working with a qualified therapist can transform your life.
sentences.zh: 系好安全带，因为在今天的节目中，我们将深入探讨与合格的治疗师合作为何能改变你的人生的关键原因。

sentences.en: Whether you're navigating personal challenges, seeking growth, or just aiming for a happier, healthier you,
sentences.zh: 无论你是在应对个人挑战、寻求成长，还是仅仅为了追求一个更快乐、更健康的自己，

sentences.en: stick around because we're about to uncover the incredible impact a skilled therapist can have on your journey to mental well-being.
sentences.zh: 请留下来，因为我们即将揭示一位优秀的治疗师对你的心理健康之旅所能产生的巨大影响。

sentences.en: Don't miss out on the insights that could shape your perspective.
sentences.zh: 不要错过这些可能重塑你观点的见解。

sentences.en: Hit that subscribe button, follow the show, and let's get started on this empowering exploration together.
sentences.zh: 点击订阅按钮，关注本节目，让我们一起开始这场赋能的探索之旅。

sentences.en: Welcome to a special collaboration on the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到《有抱负的心理学家》播客的特别合作节目。

sentences.en: I'm your host, Dr. Marianne Trent, qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是你们的主持人，玛丽安·特伦特博士，合格临床心理学家。

sentences.en: And today, I'm joined by the brilliant Dr. Tara Quinn Chirillo from the Adversity Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 今天，我邀请到了来自《逆境心理学家》播客的杰出人物塔拉·奎因·奇里洛博士。

sentences.en: As we team up for a joint episode.
sentences.zh: 我们联手制作了这期联合节目。

sentences.en: Exciting.
sentences.zh: 太令人兴奋了。

sentences.en: Together, we're delving into a topic that impacts us all.
sentences.zh: 我们将共同探讨一个影响我们所有人的话题。

sentences.en: Finding a qualified therapist in the UK.
sentences.zh: 在英国寻找合格的治疗师。

sentences.en: Join us as we unravel the importance of this journey.
sentences.zh: 加入我们，一起揭开这段旅程的重要性。

sentences.en: And share invaluable insights on navigating the world of mental health professionals.
sentences.zh: 并分享关于如何在心理健康专业人士的世界中导航的宝贵见解。

sentences.en: Whether you're an aspiring psychologist or someone seeking guidance, this conversation is packed with wisdom.
sentences.zh: 无论你是一位有抱负的心理学家，还是正在寻求指导的人，这次谈话都充满了智慧。

sentences.en: Stay tuned for a thought-provoking discussion that might just change the way you approach your mental well-being.
sentences.zh: 敬请期待这场发人深省的讨论，它可能会改变你对待心理健康的方式。

sentences.en: Let's dive in.
sentences.zh: 让我们开始吧。

sentences.en: I want to welcome you back, Tara, to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 塔拉，欢迎回到《有抱负的心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: And then, of course, this is a dual episode.
sentences.zh: 当然，这是一期双向播客。

sentences.en: Nice to have you and me together again.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能和你再次聚在一起。

sentences.en: It's lovely to see you.
sentences.zh: 见到你真好。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So, if people are listening from Aspiring Psychologist podcast, we met in August 2022.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果听众来自《有抱负的心理学家》播客，我们是在2022年8月认识的。

sentences.en: When we were thinking about the kind of tricky issues of people being appropriately qualified to do what they say they can do, weren't we?
sentences.zh: 当时我们正在思考关于人们是否具备适当资格去做他们声称能做的事情这一棘手问题，不是吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: It's that long ago, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 时间过得真快，不是吗？

sentences.en: So, a little tiny seed has now grown into a wonderful thing to try and help people understand a bit more about that.
sentences.zh: 所以，一颗小小的种子现在已经长成了一件美妙的事情，旨在帮助人们更好地理解这一点。

sentences.en: It has.
sentences.zh: 确实长成了。

sentences.en: What has our seed grown into, Tara?
sentences.zh: 塔拉，我们的种子长成了什么？

sentences.en: Oh, this is so exciting.
sentences.zh: 哦，这太令人兴奋了。

sentences.en: I can't believe we're actually going to say it.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信我们真的要说出来了。

sentences.en: So, we have written a book to help people understand.
sentences.zh: 我们写了一本书来帮助人们理解。

sentences.en: There's kind of two parts, really, aren't there?
sentences.zh: 其实大概有两个部分，对吧？

sentences.en: A little bit more about being qualified and regulated as a talking therapist in the UK,
sentences.zh: 一部分是关于在英国作为谈话治疗师的资格认证和监管，

sentences.en: but also to help you understand some things to look out for if you are going to be searching for a therapist or supporting someone else who's going to be searching for a therapist as well.
sentences.zh: 另一部分是帮助你了解如果你要寻找治疗师，或者支持他人寻找治疗师时需要注意的一些事项。

sentences.en: Yeah, and it is important because it's something that my friends and family ask me.
sentences.zh: 是的，这很重要，因为我的朋友和家人经常问我这个问题。

sentences.en: If I want to find somebody, how do I even go about kind of climbing through, wading through this quagmire?
sentences.zh: 如果我想找个人，我该如何在这片泥潭中摸索前行？

sentences.en: What do I look for?
sentences.zh: 我该寻找什么？

sentences.en: How do I make sure someone is going to be safe and okay?
sentences.zh: 我如何确保某人是安全且可靠的？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对正确。

sentences.en: And if it's all right to say, one of the things that we've learned, and we thought we were quite well-aversed in who's who and what professional bodies they're with,
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，我想说，我们学到的一件事是——我们原以为自己很了解谁是谁，以及他们属于哪些专业机构，

sentences.en: there's a lot of little gaps.
sentences.zh: 但其实还有很多信息缺口。

sentences.en: So, we've worked quite hard to inform ourselves in order to be able to inform the public, haven't we?
sentences.zh: 所以，我们非常努力地充实自己，以便能够告知公众，不是吗？

sentences.en: It's not that easy to just go and find a therapiSt.
sentences.zh: 想要找到一位治疗师并不容易。

sentences.en: There are so many terms and they're so interchangeable.
sentences.zh: 有太多的术语，而且它们经常混用。

sentences.en: It can be a bit of a difficult path to navigate.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一条很难走的路。

sentences.en: And for most people who might be looking for a therapist, you might already be feeling quite unwell.
sentences.zh: 对于大多数可能正在寻找治疗师的人来说，你可能已经感觉很不舒服了。

sentences.en: So, that's an extra barrier to get over as well.
sentences.zh: 所以，这又多了一道需要克服的障碍。

sentences.en: So, I think that's why this book means a lot to us.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这就是为什么这本书对我们意义重大。

sentences.en: Because we want to help people make that journey as easy and as safe as possible, don't we?
sentences.zh: 因为我们想帮助人们尽可能轻松、安全地完成这段旅程，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, we do.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们想。

sentences.en: And I think sometimes just trying to, you know, find that last bit of energy in the tank to find someone, almost interview them, make sure they're going to be a good fit for you,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为有时仅仅是试图挤出最后一点精力去寻找某人，几乎像面试一样去确认他们是否适合你，

sentences.en: can be exhausting.
sentences.zh: 这可能会让人精疲力竭。

sentences.en: And I don't know about you, but I've had experiences where some of my clients now have been burned from getting the wrong therapist for them.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你怎么样，但我的一些客户曾因为找错了治疗师而受到伤害。

sentences.en: And then it's taken them years to kind of lick their wounds and then come back to it again.
sentences.zh: 然后他们花了几年时间来舔舐伤口，才敢再次尝试。

sentences.en: So, this is why getting it right first time, or certainly at the time that you're looking for, that's why it matters, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是为什么第一次就找对人，或者至少在你寻找的时候找对人，是非常重要的，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We talk about therapist fit a lot, don't we?
sentences.zh: 我们经常谈论治疗师的匹配度，不是吗？

sentences.en: So, I always like to think of that on two levels.
sentences.zh: 所以我总是喜欢从两个层面来考虑这个问题。

sentences.en: So, there's the fit between you and the individual.
sentences.zh: 首先是你与个人之间的匹配度。

sentences.en: Is it someone you feel comfortable talking to?
sentences.zh: 那是一个让你感到交谈自在的人吗？

sentences.en: You know, is that person the right person for you personally?
sentences.zh: 你知道，那个人真的是适合你的人吗？

sentences.en: Because I sometimes work with people and the fit isn't right and that's okay.
sentences.zh: 因为我有时会和一些人共事，但感觉不太对，这也没关系。

sentences.en: But there's also that second level that actually is this person safe?
sentences.zh: 但还有第二个层面，那就是这个人安全吗？

sentences.en: Are they using a robust model?
sentences.zh: 他们使用的是可靠的模型吗？

sentences.en: Are they qualified in what they say they are?
sentences.zh: 他们所说的资质属实吗？

sentences.en: Can you look them up?
sentences.zh: 你能查到他们的信息吗？

sentences.en: That's the safety stuff.
sentences.zh: 这就是安全方面的问题。

sentences.en: That's the risk stuff.
sentences.zh: 这就是风险所在。

sentences.en: That's the kind of foundation for me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这就是基础。

sentences.en: And if you can have help with that, then you can start to look at, well, actually, is the fit okay?
sentences.zh: 如果有人能在这方面帮你，那你就可以开始考虑，嗯，实际上，合适吗？

sentences.en: And I think that's why our book's quite helpful because we're not just looking at where do you go to find people,
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是我们的书很有帮助的原因，因为我们不仅是在看你去哪里找人，

sentences.en: but we're helping people understand a bit more about those concepts, aren't we?
sentences.zh: 我们还在帮助人们更多地了解这些概念，不是吗？

sentences.en: And hopefully making that journey a little bit easier for them as well.
sentences.zh: 也希望让他们的这段旅程变得更容易一些。

sentences.en: We certainly are.
sentences.zh: 我们当然是这样想的。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's been a joy to work with you on this project.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，能和你一起做这个项目真是太高兴了。

sentences.en: You know, you've been so responsive.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你一直都很积极配合。

sentences.en: You've had to chase me a little bit here and there.
sentences.zh: 你还得时不时地催我一下。

sentences.en: Well, when we're both running busy practices, we both do all sorts of other things as well.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当我们都在忙于各自的工作时，我们也都还在做各种其他的事情。

sentences.en: We both, I think the kind of common ground, if it's all right to bring that in the podcast,
sentences.zh: 我们俩，我想如果我们能在播客里提到这一点的话，我们的共同点是，

sentences.en: is we like to get good, ethical, qualified information out to the public on all things emotional health, don't we?
sentences.zh: 我们都喜欢向公众传播关于心理健康的良好、合乎道德、有资质的信息，不是吗？

sentences.en: So this kind of came for us from some of that other work as well.
sentences.zh: 所以这对于我们来说，也源于我们所做的其他一些工作。

sentences.en: You know, we both do media work.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们都从事媒体工作。

sentences.en: This means a lot to us.
sentences.zh: 这对我们意义重大。

sentences.en: This isn't just about writing a book and getting information out there.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是写一本书并发布信息那么简单。

sentences.en: We care about people and we want them to have the right and the safe journey as well, don't we?
sentences.zh: 我们关心人们，我们也希望他们能拥有正确且安全的旅程，不是吗？

sentences.en: We do.
sentences.zh: 我们确实是这样。

sentences.en: I passionately care about people living distress-free lives and being able to feel better,
sentences.zh: 我非常关心人们能否过上没有痛苦的生活，并能够感觉更好，

sentences.en: you know, have that adaptive healing method that means that life doesn't feel like such a struggle.
sentences.zh: 你知道，拥有那种适应性的疗愈方法，意味着生活不会感觉那么挣扎。

sentences.en: And I guess that's the bit that I want people to hang on to because some people might feel like this is elitiSt.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是我希望人们能坚持下去的一点，因为有些人可能会觉得这很精英主义。

sentences.en: This is not us saying you must see a qualified psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说我们要求你必须去看一位合格的心理学家。

sentences.en: It's not that for me at all.
sentences.zh: 对我来说根本不是那样。

sentences.en: It's make sure you know what you're getting and that someone is the right person to see you.
sentences.zh: 而是要确保你知道你得到的是什么，并且那个人是适合为你提供咨询的人。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: I'm so glad you brought that up because as psychologists and we're both psychologists, different types of psychologists, which is also helpful for people to understand,
sentences.zh: 我很高兴你提到了这一点，因为作为心理学家——我们俩都是心理学家，虽然是不同类型的心理学家，这对人们理解也很有帮助——

sentences.en: this is not about elitism at all.
sentences.zh: 这根本不是什么精英主义。

sentences.en: This is about us wanting to help protect the public because, you know, when you listen to the podcast now, what does the word therapist mean to you?
sentences.zh: 这是因为我们想帮助保护公众，因为，你知道，当你现在听播客时，“治疗师”这个词对你意味着什么？

sentences.en: It can mean so many different things.
sentences.zh: 它可以意味着很多不同的事情。

sentences.en: We're talking about talking therapy specifically, but even within talking therapy, there are so many different types of practitioners, counsellors,
sentences.zh: 我们专门讨论的是谈话疗法，但即使在谈话疗法中，也有很多不同类型的从业者、咨询师，

sentences.en: and we want to help people learn a bit more about that.
sentences.zh: 我们想帮助人们多了解一点这方面的信息。

sentences.en: And post-pandemic, we've got a mental health crisis in the UK, so more and more people we know that are reaching out.
sentences.zh: 疫情过后，英国出现了心理健康危机，所以我们知道越来越多的人正在寻求帮助。

sentences.en: Where are they going?
sentences.zh: 他们去哪里找呢？

sentences.en: On top of that, we've got a digital age now, so more and more people are offering things online and in different formats.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，我们现在处于数字时代，所以越来越多的人在线上和以不同的形式提供服务。

sentences.en: That's a lot to navigate, even since I started my career 20-odd years ago.
sentences.zh: 即使在我20多年前开始职业生涯时，这也是一个需要去探索的复杂领域。

sentences.en: So where do you go?
sentences.zh: 所以你该去哪里？

sentences.en: Where do you start?
sentences.zh: 你从哪里开始？

sentences.en: And sometimes, if that seems really overwhelming, my concern is that people might not start that journey.
sentences.zh: 有时，如果这看起来让人不知所措，我担心人们可能根本就不会开始这段旅程。

sentences.en: They may not reach out because it just seems too much.
sentences.zh: 他们可能因为觉得太麻烦而不会去寻求帮助。

sentences.en: So we're hoping, aren't we, that this book might be bought by people like GPs, people that are going to be supporting people who might want to also look up a therapist,
sentences.zh: 所以我们希望，不是吗，这本书能被全科医生（GP）这样的人购买，他们会支持那些可能也想寻找治疗师的人，

sentences.en: not just that individual member of the public.
sentences.zh: 而不仅仅是针对公众中的个人。

sentences.en: So if we can hopefully, through our book, educate more professionals, get more conversations like this going.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我们能通过我们的书教育更多的专业人士，让更多这样的对话进行下去，那就太好了。

sentences.en: So we've liaised with different agencies that are in the book, haven't we?
sentences.zh: 所以我们已经和书中提到的不同机构进行了联络，不是吗？

sentences.en: And the fact that we can all work together to help people understand a bit more about this.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们都可以共同努力，帮助人们更多地了解这一点。

sentences.en: And starting conversations, that's what we can do.
sentences.zh: 开启对话，这就是我们能做的。

sentences.en: We can all do that.
sentences.zh: 我们都能做到。

sentences.en: We're doing it right now, aren't we?
sentences.zh: 我们现在就在做，不是吗？

sentences.en: Well, you're a master at that, obviously, with your conversation starter project.
sentences.zh: 嗯，显然你是这方面的大师，通过你的“对话启动者”项目。

sentences.en: But that's another little passion project for you that has really grown beautifully in 2023.
sentences.zh: 但那是你的另一个小热情项目，在2023年确实发展得很棒。

sentences.en: So just in case people are listening, they're like, I don't know what that is.
sentences.zh: 所以以防有人在听，他们会想，我不知道那是什么。

sentences.en: This is where Tara set up with a friend and colleague of hers, that people could just meet and walk and talk and have conversations.
sentences.zh: 这是Tara和她的一位朋友兼同事共同发起的，人们可以见面、散步、交谈并进行对话。

sentences.en: And it's, it's grown to something beautiful.
sentences.zh: 它已经发展成了一件美好的事情。

sentences.en: But yeah.
sentences.zh: 但确实如此。

sentences.en: So back to the book.
sentences.zh: 回到书上。

sentences.en: What have we called it?
sentences.zh: 我们把它叫什么名字？

sentences.en: And where can people get it?
sentences.zh: 人们在哪里可以买到它？

sentences.en: What is our book called?
sentences.zh: 我们的书叫什么？

sentences.en: It's called Talking Heads.
sentences.zh: 它叫《Talking Heads》。

sentences.en: It's your guide to finding a qualified therapist in the UK.
sentences.zh: 这是你在英国寻找合格治疗师的指南。

sentences.en: And hopefully, you'll be able to find it on Amazon.
sentences.zh: 希望你能在亚马逊上找到它。

sentences.en: Super easy.
sentences.zh: 超级简单。

sentences.en: Hopefully, you'll be able to tell your friends and your family about it.
sentences.zh: 希望你能告诉你的朋友和家人。

sentences.en: We're hoping it's a really easy read, a nice, easy, digestible book, broken down into some really easy read sections.
sentences.zh: 我们希望它读起来非常轻松，是一本好读、易消化的书，拆分成了几个非常易读的章节。

sentences.en: And something, again, that people can just start conversations about.
sentences.zh: 而且，再次强调，这是人们可以借此开启对话的东西。

sentences.en: There's this book.
sentences.zh: 有这本书。

sentences.en: Read it.
sentences.zh: 读读它。

sentences.en: Or I've read this in a book.
sentences.zh: 或者我已经在书里读到过这个了。

sentences.en: Let's share that with people.
sentences.zh: 让我们与大家分享一下。

sentences.en: And we're really pleased, actually, aren't we, about it?
sentences.zh: 而且我们真的很高兴，不是吗？

sentences.en: Sometimes it's hard when we've all got busy lives.
sentences.zh: 有时候，当我们生活都很忙碌时，这很难。

sentences.en: We're both parents as well to try and get something completed, getting an idea completed.
sentences.zh: 我们俩也都是父母，要努力完成某件事，完成一个想法。

sentences.en: But it just shows that something really matters.
sentences.zh: 但这恰恰说明有些事情真的很重要。

sentences.en: You can do that, can't you?
sentences.zh: 你能做到，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And, you know, it felt like launching it in January is kind of a really good time because often people might be having New Year's resolutions.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，感觉在一月份发布这本书是一个非常好的时机，因为人们通常会有新年决心。

sentences.en: They might be thinking, what would I want to be different this time next year?
sentences.zh: 他们可能会想，明年这个时候我希望有什么不同？

sentences.en: Mental health and child wellness goals are kind of common in that.
sentences.zh: 心理健康和儿童健康目标在其中很常见。

sentences.en: And so it felt like a really important time to launch this book.
sentences.zh: 所以，感觉现在是发布这本书的一个非常重要的时刻。

sentences.en: And I think as well, the media started to talk a little bit more about the mental health crisis we have in the UK.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，媒体也开始更多地谈论我们在英国面临的心理健康危机。

sentences.en: But also we're seeing more and more.
sentences.zh: 但我们也看到了越来越多（的情况）。

sentences.en: And we've had some messages as well ourselves, haven't we, in conversations with people who have maybe seen someone that they've had concerns about or are just noticing
sentences.zh: 我们自己也收到了一些信息，不是吗？在与那些可能看到他们所关心的人，或者只是注意到的人交谈时，

sentences.en: that there's more and more options available to manage your mental health.
sentences.zh: （发现）管理心理健康的选项越来越多了。

sentences.en: The rise of coaching in the UK, for example, is something really important to bring in here.
sentences.zh: 例如，英国教练行业的兴起，是这里一个非常重要的切入点。

sentences.en: And we just want to help people to navigate all of that information and when better than at the start of the year.
sentences.zh: 我们只是想帮助人们梳理所有这些信息，而年初正是最好的时机。

sentences.en: Sometimes after Christmas, Christmas can be a tricky time for many people, actually.
sentences.zh: 有时候在圣诞节之后，其实圣诞节对许多人来说可能是一个棘手的时期。

sentences.en: Might be a time where people start to reflect, as you say, make some resolutions or just think about where they might want to make some life choices.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一个人们开始反思的时刻，正如你所说，做出一些决定，或者只是思考他们可能想在哪些方面做出生活选择。

sentences.en: So perfect time to have a guide to help you with that journey.
sentences.zh: 所以，拥有一本指南来帮助你完成这段旅程是完美的时机。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I know when I was working in the NHS, sometimes people would say, well, if I wanted to find a qualified private therapist, where would I go?
sentences.zh: 我知道当我在英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）工作时，有时人们会问，如果我想找一位合格的私人治疗师，我该去哪里？

sentences.en: At which point you're not really supposed to make recommendations.
sentences.zh: 在那一点上，你其实不应该做出推荐。

sentences.en: So this might be a really nice kind of signpost to say, actually, there's this that's available that can help you through that process.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能是一个非常好的路标，说明实际上，有这样的资源可以帮助你完成这个过程。

sentences.en: Because this is not a high cost price.
sentences.zh: 因为这不是一个高价的产品。

sentences.en: It's not even particularly long as a book.
sentences.zh: 这本书甚至不算特别长。

sentences.en: You know, it's just getting this out there as a robust
sentences.zh: 你知道，这只是为了把它作为一个稳健的、

sentences.en: and valid and useful information source.
sentences.zh: 有效的且有用的信息来源发布出来。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: And again, yeah, we both have background in the NHS, don't we?
sentences.zh: 再说一次，是的，我们俩都有在NHS工作的背景，不是吗？

sentences.en: And sometimes there can be these barriers, understandable ones, to being able to signpost people in the right direction.
sentences.zh: 有时在引导人们走向正确方向时，可能会存在一些可以理解的障碍。

sentences.en: But it is really hard, though, because sometimes that leaves people in uncertain places.
sentences.zh: 但这确实很难，因为有时这会让人们处于不确定的境地。

sentences.en: And people will know I am Mrs. Risk averse.
sentences.zh: 人们会知道我是“风险规避夫人”。

sentences.en: I don't like people being left in a situation where they may end up seeing someone who could put them at risk, put their mental health at risk.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢人们处于一种可能最终见到一个会让他们面临风险、让他们的心理健康面临风险的人的情况中。

sentences.en: And we both know that there are people out there who are offering services that would come under the umbrella of mental health who should not be doing that.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道，外面有一些人提供的服务属于心理健康范畴，但他们本不应该这样做。

sentences.en: And we're big and bold, aren't we?
sentences.zh: 而且我们很大胆，不是吗？

sentences.en: We don't mind starting conversations about that.
sentences.zh: 我们不介意开启关于这个话题的对话。

sentences.en: So, you know, this isn't about bashing people.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这不是为了抨击别人。

sentences.en: It's just about making the public aware that some titles for some therapists in the UK are not protected and that anybody can set themselves up
sentences.zh: 这只是为了让公众意识到，在英国，一些治疗师的头衔并没有受到保护，任何人都可以自称为

sentences.en: as certain types of therapists or talking therapists in the UK, which is mind-blowing when you think about it.
sentences.zh: 英国的某些类型的治疗师或谈话治疗师，当你想到这一点时，真是令人震惊。

sentences.en: And some people, if it's okay to say, can hide behind certain names.
sentences.zh: 如果可以这样说的话，有些人可以躲在某些头衔后面。

sentences.en: And we might not question those names because they have power behind them.
sentences.zh: 而我们可能不会质疑这些头衔，因为它们背后有权威性。

sentences.en: So part of the book is helping also to deconstruct some of those titles, helping people learn a little bit more about how people can operate.
sentences.zh: 所以这本书的一部分也是帮助解构其中一些头衔，帮助人们多了解一点人们是如何执业的。

sentences.en: So you can spot it, so you can be brave and ask those questions about who you're seeing, what their qualifications are,
sentences.zh: 这样你就能识别出来，这样你就能勇敢地询问你正在看的人，他们的资质是什么，

sentences.en: who they are regulated with, who's keeping an eye on the work that they do and what that could look like.
sentences.zh: 他们受谁监管，谁在监督他们的工作，以及这看起来会是什么样子。

sentences.en: So we both know, don't we, that on websites, sometimes people can have logos that look super fancy, look like they're a member of an organisation, but actually they are not.
sentences.zh: 所以我们都知道，不是吗，在网站上，有时人们会有看起来超级华丽的标志，看起来像是某个组织的成员，但实际上他们并不是。

sentences.en: So we've put some information in there, haven't we, to help people navigate that, which for me is a really, really important part of why we're doing this.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在书中加入了一些信息，不是吗，来帮助人们梳理这些，对我来说，这是我们做这件事非常、非常重要的一部分。

sentences.en: It really is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It's just about safety, integrity, ethics, and, you know, what we think about is efficacious treatment, stuff that actually gets results, that helps people achieve their goals,
sentences.zh: 这只是关于安全、诚信、道德，而且，你知道，我们认为什么是有效的治疗，真正能取得成果、帮助人们实现目标的东西，

sentences.en: whatever that might be.
sentences.zh: 无论那可能是什么。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And for some people, it's a huge thing, isn't it, to notice that something isn't okay with your emotional health, to think about taking that big, bold, and often vulnerable step
sentences.zh: 对一些人来说，注意到自己的情绪健康出了问题，去考虑迈出那一大步、勇敢且往往脆弱的一步，是一件大事，不是吗？

sentences.en: to find someone to talk to.
sentences.zh: 去寻找可以倾诉的人。

sentences.en: For people that haven't been through that journey before, it can be a little bit daunting talking to a stranger about your kind of inner thoughts, your inner feelings.
sentences.zh: 对于以前没有经历过这段旅程的人来说，向陌生人谈论你内心的想法、内心的感受可能会有点令人生畏。

sentences.en: And we want to make sure that people are doing that in a way that's supportive and protective for them.
sentences.zh: 我们想确保人们以一种对他们有支持和保护作用的方式来做这件事。

sentences.en: Because as you quite rightly pointed out at the beginning of the podcast, it can be damaging to some people, and that damage can take time to repair,
sentences.zh: 因为正如你在播客开头非常正确地指出的那样，这对某些人来说可能是破坏性的，而这种伤害可能需要时间来修复，

sentences.en: and sometimes it's irreparable.
sentences.zh: 有时甚至是无法修复的。

sentences.en: So we want to really help people on that journey.
sentences.zh: 所以我们真的想在这一旅程中帮助人们。

sentences.en: So we're both super ethical, aren't we?
sentences.zh: 所以我们俩都超级有道德，不是吗？

sentences.en: We care about people.
sentences.zh: 我们关心人们。

sentences.en: That's where this book is coming from.
sentences.zh: 这就是这本书的初衷。

sentences.en: And I'm hoping that anybody who's listened to this podcast, whether you are someone who is thinking of reaching out for therapy yourself or supporting someone you know,
sentences.zh: 我希望任何听过这个播客的人，无论你是正在考虑自己寻求治疗的人，还是支持你认识的人，

sentences.en: or whether you're someone who's in an organisation where you regularly maybe get asked to signpost people, those are the people that we also want to tap into as well.
sentences.zh: 或者你是在一个经常可能被要求引导人们的组织里的人，这些人也是我们想要触及的对象。

sentences.en: In a nutshell, what do we want people to experience from this?
sentences.zh: 简而言之，我们希望人们从中体验到什么？

sentences.en: So my background and passion is working in learning disability services, and one of the things that I learnt working with that wonderful client group
sentences.zh: 我的背景和热情是在学习障碍服务部门工作，我在与那个很棒的客户群体一起工作时学到的事情之一，

sentences.en: is about making informed choices, helping people to have the right information, you then weigh it up and make the best choice for them.
sentences.zh: 就是关于做出明智的选择，帮助人们获得正确的信息，然后你权衡利弊，为他们做出最好的选择。

sentences.en: So with this book, we are providing you with the information and the understanding you need about how talking therapists can operate in the UK in order for you then to go and check
sentences.zh: 所以通过这本书，我们为你提供了关于谈话治疗师如何在英国执业的必要信息和理解，以便你随后去核实

sentences.en: the person or persons that you're looking at.
sentences.zh: 你正在考虑的那个人或那些人。

sentences.en: To begin, also, second really important point, to have conversations, to be bold and ask them.
sentences.zh: 首先，第二个非常重要的点，要进行对话，要勇敢地询问他们。

sentences.en: So if you can take one little nugget from this, if you're looking up someone, getting to the point where you're going to book an appointment,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你能从中得到一点收获，如果你正在查找某人，到了准备预约的地步，

sentences.en: ask them, how do I find out who you're registered with?
sentences.zh: 问他们，我怎么才能查到你在哪里注册的？

sentences.en: And actually go and look them up.
sentences.zh: 并且真的去查一下他们。

sentences.en: That's the really important thing.
sentences.zh: 那才是真正重要的事情。

sentences.en: Being okay with having tricky conversations.
sentences.zh: 能够坦然面对棘手的对话。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: So obviously the beauty of a podcast episode is that it's not just for the week that it's launched.
sentences.zh: 显然，播客节目的美妙之处在于它不仅仅是为了发布的那一周。

sentences.en: It's an eternal, beautiful beast, you know.
sentences.zh: 它是一个永恒的、美丽的野兽，你知道的。

sentences.en: But given that this is, you know, January,
sentences.zh: 但鉴于现在是，你知道，一月份，

sentences.en: what would be your hopes or wishes or a kind of advice for how our listeners can have a gentler journey in 2024, Tara?
sentences.zh: Tara，你对我们的听众如何在2024年拥有更温和的旅程有什么希望、愿望或建议吗？

sentences.en: What would I like for people in 2024?
sentences.zh: 我希望人们在2024年得到什么？

sentences.en: I would like people to be more compassionate to themselves if they are struggling, to be okay with having conversations.
sentences.zh: 我希望人们在挣扎时能对自己更富有同情心，能坦然面对对话。

sentences.en: Those conversations can be a huge help to you, to others.
sentences.zh: 这些对话对你、对他人都会有巨大的帮助。

sentences.en: They can be that first stepping stone to feeling better about yourselves.
sentences.zh: 它们可以成为让你对自己感觉更好的第一块垫脚石。

sentences.en: And as you said, quite rightly, Marianne, we're all about people feeling better, aren't we?
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，Marianne，你说得很对，我们所做的一切都是为了让人们感觉更好，不是吗？

sentences.en: You know, that doesn't always have to be in a clinical setting.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这并不总是必须在临床环境中进行。

sentences.en: We can start daily conversations.
sentences.zh: 我们可以开始日常的对话。

sentences.en: I'd like more of that in 2024.
sentences.zh: 我希望在2024年能有更多这样的对话。

sentences.en: Checking in on people.
sentences.zh: 关心人们。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: How are you really?
sentences.zh: 你真的好吗？

sentences.en: Following it up.
sentences.zh: 跟进它。

sentences.en: I'm waiting for that response.
sentences.zh: 我在等待那个回应。

sentences.en: That's my top thing.
sentences.zh: 这是我最重要的事情。

sentences.en: Oh, that's so nice.
sentences.zh: 哦，那太好了。

sentences.en: Is that good?
sentences.zh: 那很好吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I do that more now.
sentences.zh: 我现在更多地这样做。

sentences.en: I do it in my own life.
sentences.zh: 我在我自己的生活中这样做。

sentences.en: How are you on the school path?
sentences.zh: 你在学校路上怎么样？

sentences.en: And I'm still walking and now making that effort to either not ask if I can't stop or to go, how are you really?
sentences.zh: 我还在走，现在努力要么如果不方便停下来就不问，要么就去问，你真的好吗？

sentences.en: And I've got time to listen.
sentences.zh: 而且我有时间倾听。

sentences.en: Or shall we make time?
sentences.zh: 或者我们应该腾出时间吗？

sentences.en: It really makes such a big difference, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 这真的有很大的不同，不是吗？

sentences.en: I always use the school path metaphor for all of that stuff that we ask, hi, how are you?
sentences.zh: 我总是用学校路上的比喻来形容我们问的所有那些事情，嗨，你好吗？

sentences.en: And we're still walking.
sentences.zh: 而我们还在走。

sentences.en: We don't stop.
sentences.zh: 我们不停下来。

sentences.en: Maybe we just say hi then.
sentences.zh: 也许我们只是打个招呼。

sentences.en: Yeah, if we know we haven't got time to stop.
sentences.zh: 是的，如果我们知道我们没有时间停下来。

sentences.en: That's my thing now.
sentences.zh: 这就是我现在的事情。

sentences.en: If I haven't got time to ask, I don't ask now.
sentences.zh: 如果我没有时间问，我现在就不问了。

sentences.en: It's really made a big difference.
sentences.zh: 这真的产生了很大的不同。

sentences.en: Or if I notice someone, I'll be like, we should catch up.
sentences.zh: 或者如果我注意到某人，我会说，我们应该聚聚。

sentences.en: It's been so lovely chatting with you.
sentences.zh: 和你聊天真是太愉快了。

sentences.en: Thank you for welcoming me back to your audience.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你欢迎我回到你的听众中。

sentences.en: And thank you for sharing your time with my audience too.
sentences.zh: 也谢谢你与我的听众分享你的时间。

sentences.en: Looking forward to what 2024 brings for you.
sentences.zh: 期待2024年为你带来什么。

sentences.en: Thanks for being such a lovely part of my 2023 and providing all this wonderful content that you do absolutely for free, often for the people that are in your life.
sentences.zh: 感谢你成为我2023年如此可爱的一部分，并提供了所有这些你所做的精彩内容，通常是完全免费的，为了你生命中的人们。

sentences.en: And may 2024 be prosperous for you and for everyone you care about.
sentences.zh: 愿2024年对你和你关心的人来说是繁荣的。

sentences.en: Feelings are very mutual.
sentences.zh: 彼此的感觉是一样的。

sentences.en: People need to hear more about Marianne and the fantastic work you do and the fantastic person that you are as well.
sentences.zh: 人们需要更多地了解Marianne，了解你所做的出色工作，以及你也是一个出色的人。

sentences.en: Thanks, Tara.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，Tara。

sentences.en: That's really kind.
sentences.zh: 你真好。

sentences.en: So yeah, looking forward to,
sentences.zh: 所以是的，期待着，

sentences.en: I'm sure we'll chat again on our podcast in future.
sentences.zh: 我相信我们将来会在我们的播客上再次聊天。

sentences.en: If people did want to check out Talking Heads, your guide to finding a qualified therapist in the UK, they can do that by checking the links in our show notes,
sentences.zh: 如果人们确实想查看《Talking Heads：你在英国寻找合格治疗师的指南》，他们可以通过查看我们节目说明中的链接来做到这一点，

sentences.en: on our socials or by going straight to Amazon.
sentences.zh: 在我们的社交媒体上，或者直接去亚马逊。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for your time, Tara.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你的时间，Tara。

sentences.en: A pleasure as always.
sentences.zh: 一如既往，是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: And that's a wrap for this eye-opening episode of both the Aspiring Psychologist Podcast and the Adversity Psychologist PodcaSt.
sentences.zh: 这就是《Aspiring Psychologist Podcast》和《Adversity Psychologist Podcast》这一期大开眼界的节目的结尾。

sentences.en: A huge thank you to our fantastic co-host,
sentences.zh: 非常感谢我们出色的联合主持人，

sentences.en: Dr. Tara Quinn-Cherillo, for joining me, Dr. Marianne Trent, in this insightful conversation on finding qualified therapists in the UK.
sentences.zh: Tara Quinn-Cherillo博士，加入我，Marianne Trent博士，进行这次关于在英国寻找合格治疗师的深刻对话。

sentences.en: If you have found value in today's discussion, don't forget to hit the like button, subscribe to the Aspiring Psychologist Podcast and the Adversity Psychologist Podcast
sentences.zh: 如果你在今天的讨论中发现了价值，别忘了点击点赞按钮，订阅《Aspiring Psychologist Podcast》和《Adversity Psychologist Podcast》，

sentences.en: for more great content and share your thoughts in the comments.
sentences.zh: 以获取更多精彩内容，并在评论中分享你的想法。

sentences.en: If you're listening on MP3, please do subscribe to the shows.
sentences.zh: 如果你是在MP3上收听，请务必订阅这些节目。

sentences.en: Please also check out the other recommended videos which are on screen if you're watching on YouTube now.
sentences.zh: 如果你现在正在YouTube上观看，也请查看屏幕上推荐的其他视频。

sentences.en: Remember, your mental health journey is uniquely yours and the right therapist can make all the difference.
sentences.zh: 记住，你的心理健康之旅是你独有的，合适的治疗师可以带来完全不同的结果。

sentences.en: Stay tuned for more engaging episodes and until next time, take care of yourselves.
sentences.zh: 敬请期待更多引人入胜的剧集，下次见，照顾好自己。

sentences.en: Thanks for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 感谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到钱，而不仅仅是用时间换金钱，会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是Marianne Trent博士，临床心理学家，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一些令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's one-to-many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote的一对多项目现在开放注册了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将你的专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家完成他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得Sophie的奖金，加上我自己的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次小组策划、大师班、个性化指导、Fortnum and Mason的款待以及限时的一对一辅导奖金。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10 p.m.
sentences.zh: 注册于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖金页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖金。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，随时可以找我。
